I1.description: wide control: product + 6 month-name columns, numeric data rows

I2.description: long control: Product | Kuukausi | Myynti with one row per product-month

I3.description: unknown control: quarterly summary (Q1-Q4 + Vuosi), no month-name tokens

pass_criteria.overall: I1 AND I2 AND I3 all i_pass

counterfactual: det_classify == expected_format (would a rule alone suffice? non-scoring for pass, recorded per probe)

decision_table.probes: I1 & I2 pass, I3 not run

stated_limitations: The deterministic classifier is a coarse month-token heuristic. It is correct on the clean wide/long controls and on the no-month (quarterly) case. It is WRONG on a transposed wide table (months as rows): months land in a data column and the rule says 'long'. That case is deferred and noted as where the LLM would add value.

The gate is a VERIFIER, not an authority: it checks the LLM's label is objectively supported by the token criteria; it does not substitute its own answer (the criteria are too coarse to be authoritative, unlike H's coverage==12).
n=1 on GLM-5.2, no seed control: existence, not reliability.
Classification only. No unpivot/reshape/transformation is produced or evaluated (hard stop honored).
